json.notes: The Conservatory of Flowers is a white painted-timber glasshouse: a central domed pavilion on a drum with a small cupola on top, flanked by long barrel-vaulted glass wings running east and west, each ending in a small domed end pavilion. The signature features are the central dome with its finial and the long curved glazed wings, so I model those as the main masses.

final.notes: The Conservatory of Flowers is a white painted-timber glasshouse: a central domed pavilion on a drum with a small cupola on top, flanked by long barrel-vaulted glass wings running east and west, each ending in a small domed end pavilion. The signature features are the central dome with its finial and the long curved glazed wings, so I model those as the main masses.
